snippet.title: CATCAR Pit Crew Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Every race team needs a good pit crew. 🔧 Wishlist CATCAR Pit Crew on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/5039630/CATCAR_Pit_Crew/

CATCAR Pit Crew is a chaotic co-op game where you and your friends play as a racing pit crew instead of the driver. Swap tires, refuel, and patch up your car as fast as you can. Every second in the pit counts, and only a crew that works together can bring home the win.

🏁 Co-op pit stop action: coordinate with your team to pull off lightning-fast stops
👥 Best with 4 players: and there's no cap, so bring the whole crew
🔧 Teamwork wins races: communication matters more than speed alone

📅 Coming soon. Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5039630/CATCAR_Pit_Crew/
